title: Name per-extension metrics by the bare extension instead of "  *.ext"
target_unit: getLinesOfCodePerExtension() and merge() in LandscapeAnalysisResults (file of 1,133 LOC, very high risk); plus one-line edits in SourceCodeAspectUtils.getAspectsPerExtensions and AnalysisUtils.analyze
notes: The reference change is +17/-7 in main code (SourceCodeAspectUtils names the per-extension aspect by the bare extension and gains an extensionName() helper stripping the legacy decoration; AnalysisUtils drops its replace("*.", ""); LandscapeAnalysisResults' per-extension aggregation and its merge() key both spellings by extensionName) plus two existing tests updated from "  *.java" to "java" (CodeConfigurationTest, NamedSourceCodeAspectTest) — an agent that only fixes the names will break those two tests unless it updates them. In B the aggregation lives in the package-private helper LandscapeExtensionAggregator (206 lines). The acceptance test has two methods: the per-extension entries of a scope analysis (AnalysisUtils.analyze on a synthetic aspect: names java/js, metric ids LINES_OF_CODE_MAIN_EXT_JAVA unchanged) and the landscape merge of a legacy-named and a bare-named repository (main: [java=150, kt=20, xml=10] with java listing both repositories; other: [sh=8, md=7]). Verification: A before — compiles, 2/2 fail ([  *.java=50,   *.js=10] and [  *.java=100, java=50, kt=20,   *.xml=10]); A after (reference diff applied with patch -p1, applies cleanly) — 2/2 pass, module 343 tests green; B before — compiles unchanged, same 2 failures; B after (same change ported into LandscapeExtensionAggregator, AnalysisUtils and SourceCodeAspectUtils identical to A) — 2/2 pass, module 343 tests green.
